verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents some background behaviors it runs itself: release plans and ramp schedules that raise a rule's rollout over time, rule scheduling, and automatic stale-flag detection. There is no general automation builder; the deploy-script toggle endpoint and the MCP bridge are user-side or developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, user-defined triggers and actions beyond rollout ramps, documentation of autonomous agent-driven background runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
